source: SOLIT2 Engineering Guidance Annex 2 section 6.2 (Class A without cover)

measured_notes.target_ignited: Annex 7 section 7.2.1's pass condition, inferred rather than read off a measurement. Annex 2 section 6.2 does not state a per-test target outcome. The basis is: section 5.2.6 requires a fire target in every Class A test and Annex 7 Figure 12 captions one as an "Example of undamaged target after a fire test"; section 7.2.1 makes non-ignition the pass condition, "Prevention of fire spread is essential in every case"; and Annex 2 section 6.2 reports this test as a successful suppressed test -- the same, with "The radiation was blocked by the water mist", and its Figure 16 shows the "Target object after a fire test with a SOLIT truck fire load". Treat as an inference, not a published datum.
measured_notes.backlayering: Read off the U15 thermocouple tree, as Annex 2 judged it (Figure 20; section 6.2: 'Although the fire reached ~ 20 MW with an air velocity of only 1-1,5 m/s, no back layering was observed'). Figure 20 is not perfectly flat: the 5.0 m thermocouple spikes intermittently to about 40 C between 0:18 and 0:23, at the HRR peak, the tip of a marginal layer touching U15. The text's 'no' is kept as the measured value.
measured_notes.peak_hrr_mw: Read off Figure 18, not the summary text. Digitised at 250 dpi, the HRR trace peaks at 15.2 MW as a 30 s median (16.1 MW at its highest single point) near 0:19; 15.5 MW is kept between the two. Section 6.2's summary says the fire 'reached ~ 20 MW', which this anchor used to carry, but the figure is the measurement and the text rounds it. c4's 30 MW agrees with its own Figure 9 (29.3 MW as a 30 s median), so only c5 needed correcting.

input_notes.incubation_s: Digitised from the SOLIT2 Engineering Guidance Annex 2 v2.1 PDF at 250 dpi: the plot frame fixes both axes, the red 'Start BBA/FFFS' line fixes activation, and the HRR trace is the per-column median of the blue curve. Figure 18 reads 3.55 MW over the 30 s before activation, whose line it places at 245 s (240 s kept). 0.1876 * (240 - 102)^2 = 3.57 MW; the preset's 60 s gave 6.1 MW. Annex 2 section 6.2: 'After 1-2 minutes the fire growth rate started raised rapidly', consistent with 102 s.
